requirements.text: 3-5 years of full-stack engineering experience, ideally at a startup or fast-moving team
3-5 years of full-stack engineering experience, ideally at a startup or fast-moving team
You've shipped real production frontends and you know your way around TypeScript, component architecture, state management, and modern build tooling
You can work across the stack: build the frontend, wire up the API, work with the database. Front-end leaning is fine, back-end leaning is not (they need you shipping UI)
You use Claude, Cursor, or equivalent AI tools daily. You're not skeptical of AI coding, you're getting fluent with it because you know it's leverage
This team moves fast, ships often, and iterates. If you're coming from a slower environment, that's fine, but this role isn't a good fit if you want to move at big-company pace
E-commerce or marketplace background is a plus but not required. If you've built two-sided products, transaction flows, or seller/buyer experiences, tell us
